understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When there were multiple goals, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A piece was selected and moved by clicking a target position. Movement was constrained by obstacles and walls; clicks on unreachable or blocked positions had no effect. Pieces could interact with obstacles or other pieces according to the puzzle's movement rules, and each click consumed a limited step. Careful route planning was necessary because moving back and forth used up the finite step budget.
